purpose: v9 rig co-generation pilot (Jin's direction 2026-08-23): the v8 recipe plus one rig token per temporal latent index (temporal_compression x 27 joints x 2D screen coords, [-1,1]) appended to the token sequence and denoised under the same rectified flow with a shared per-sample timestep; rig flow loss weight 1. Rig ground truth from cache rig.npy (bit-exact joint_xy from the dataset's source parquet, foreground-hit rate 1.0). Matched control: the t5-small 10k arm of the text pilot (identical v8 recipe, same fresh 10k cosine, no rig). Verdict: (i) pixel oracle metrics not worse than control, (ii) emitted-rig plausibility (bone lengths, on-figure rate vs generated pixels), (iii) rig-space per-prompt alignment. Single seed. Design doc: paper/refs/v9_rig_cogen_design.md.

frozen_model.backbone: full spatiotemporal DiT with signed local temporal and spatial 3D RoPE
frozen_model.teacher_forcing: clean ground-truth history during training; generated history during rollout

validation.claim_limit: Single-seed combined-treatment run; attribution of any gain to individual components rests on the matched 2k pilots, not on this run.

matched_control: results/m6v8_text_t5small_10k_s0 (v8 recipe, same budget, no rig)
